skill_name: Imagine a possible benefit of companies using AI for their employees' hiring procedure.
workflow: Companies using AI for their employees' hiring procedure may benefit by being able to quickly identify and select the most qualified candidates for available positions. AI tools are able to analyze larger candidate databases than traditional manual review processes, drastically reducing the amount of time spent searching for qualified applicants.
